SIP SIP

Systematic Investment Plan: investing a fixed amount at regular intervals into a fund.

हिंदी में: SIP

Systematic Investment Plan: किसी फंड में नियमित अंतराल पर तय राशि निवेश करना।

How it is used in the lessons

A SIP (Systematic Investment Plan) invests a fixed amount at regular intervals, usually monthly, into the scheme you choose.
